prompt: Photorealistic studio product rendering, half-section side view of a finger-scale robotic touch fingertip, about fingertip sized, mounted on a short rigid finger stub. Front quarter cut away to reveal layered stack. Top: matte soft-silicone dome with fine concentric ridges, lightly indented on top by the pad of an adult index fingertip pressing down, fingertip skin only, cropped close, giving true scale. Directly under dome: translucent soft gel interlayer bulging slightly at rim. Under gel: ultra-thin translucent vibration film, then a dark gridded capacitive taxel tile array sitting on flat facets of a light rigid faceted core with nail-back and dovetail mount. Thin amber flex tail loops with a gentle bend from the tile area dorsally to a small green readout circuit board with black chips mounted on the back of the core, with a thin black message cable exiting the board out of frame. Plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop, soft product lighting, real material textures, slight compression of dome and gel showing load. Clean legible callouts on small light tags in empty space with thin leader lines to each layer, no other text.
must_not: full hands, faces or additional people
cutaway drawing colors or sketch marks
extra text, legends or measurement graphics

visual_plan.view: Close-up side half-section, eye-level slightly above, cut plane through dome center to show conforming layers, facet tiles, core, flex bend, and dorsal board
visual_plan.spatial_layout: Top to bottom stack: adult fingertip contact on domed ridged skin, gel, vibration film, capacitive grid, faceted rigid core and mount. Side: flex tail in U-bend from stack to dorsal readout board, cable exiting rearward. Section cut from front to expose layers, board offset dorsally clear of contact
visual_plan.operating_moment: Steady light touch under grip load with incipient slip: dome slightly flattened at contact, gel bulged at edge, electronics live, slip signal path active to cable
visual_plan.transfer_path: Pressure: ridged dome to gel to vibration film to capacitive grid to rigid core; Signal: capacitive grid via flex tail to on-finger board and vibration film direct to board, then via message cable toward hand
visual_plan.interactions: Probe fingertip presses dome down; dome spreads and compresses gel; gel presses vibration film and capacitive tiles; tiles sit fixed on faceted core facets; core reacts upward into mount; flex tail carries analog signals to dorsal board; board sends message down cable
